verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਿਰਜਾਦਾ ਹਿੰਦੂਆਂ ਗਊ ਮਾਸੁ ਅਖਾਜੁ।
verses.translit_en: jiau mirajaadhaa hi(n)dhooaa(n) guoo maas akhaaju|

en.bdb: As the cow meat is forbidden in Hindu code of conduct;
The Musalmans pledge against the pork and the interest on money;

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹੁਰਾ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਾਈਐ ਪਾਣੀ ਮਦ ਰਾਜੁ।
verses.translit_en: sahuraa ghar jaavaieeaai paanee madh raaju|

en.bdb: For father-in-law, even the water of the house of son-in-law is prohibited like the wine;

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਾ ਨ ਖਾਈ ਚੂਹੜਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ।
verses.translit_en: sahaa na khaiee choohaRaa maiaa muhataaju|

en.bdb: The scanvenger eats not rabbit, though he be hard of money;

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਿਠੈ ਮਖੀ ਮਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਕਾਜੁ।
verses.translit_en: jiau miThai makhee marai tis hoi akaaju|

en.bdb: As the dead fly makes the taste of sweet bad and the sweet getting poisonous becomes useless,

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਧਰਮਸਾਲ ਦੀ ਝਾਕ ਹੈ ਵਿਹੁ ਖੰਡੂਪਾਜੁ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit_en: tiau dharamasaal dhee jhaak hai vih kha(n)ddoopaaj ||12||

en.bdb: Similarly to set one's eye upon the earning of the religious place is like eating of sugar coated poison.
